title: Target compiler (--target-compiler)
summary: Names the Delphi the code is for: lint drops advice needing a newer compiler; index parses `VER<N>0` / `CompilerVersion` branches for it
intro: Read this when your code must still build on an older Delphi (12, 10.4, XE7, 5 ...): pass --target-compiler or set target_compiler in drag-lint-lint.json, and lint stops suggesting syntax that compiler cannot take.

surfaces.path: drag-lint > Code Quality > Run Lint All (Full Report)...
